headline: A law names the Boulder, Colorado post office building after Officer Eric H. Talley.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1905 15th Street in Boulder, Colorado, as the Officer Eric H. Talley Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 10, 2022.
